candidates.title: Wrong value of the 2-dimensional character on the 4-cycle
candidates.location: example S_4 / 2次元 bullet and table
candidates.quote: $S_{3}$ の標準表現を持ち上げると $(2,0,2,-1,0)$（$(1\,2\,3\,4)$ は位数 2 の元、すなわち互換に移る）。
candidates.problem: The 4-cycle (1 2 3 4) maps to the permutation (1 2)(3 4) of the three partitions {12|34},{13|24},{14|23}, which is a product of two transpositions, not a transposition. The standard character of S_3 takes value 0 on a transposition and -1 on a double transposition. Hence the lifted character is (2,0,2,-1,-1), not (2,0,2,-1,0). The table row 「2 次元」 also lists 0 in the (1 2 3 4) column, which is wrong; it should be -1. (The orthogonality check in the problem uses the correct value -1, so the table is internally inconsistent.)
candidates.defense: One might think the 4-cycle acts as a transposition on the three partitions, but direct computation shows (1 2 3 4) sends {12|34}→{13|24}→{12|34} and fixes {14|23}, i.e. it is (1 2), a double transposition, on which the standard character of S_3 vanishes. So the value must be -1.
candidates.proposed_fix: Change the parenthetical to 「$(1\,2\,3\,4)$ は互換どうしの積（2 個の互換の積）に移る」 and the character to $(2,0,2,-1,-1)$; change the table entry in the (1 2 3 4) column of the 2-dimensional row from 0 to -1.

second_opinion.reason: The 4-cycle (1 2 3 4) acts on the three partitions {12|34},{13|24},{14|23} by sending {12|34} to {14|23}, {13|24} to itself, and {14|23} to {12|34}, i.e. it maps to the double transposition (1 3), not to a transposition. The standard character of S_3 is 2 on identity, 0 on transpositions, and -1 on the double transposition, so the lifted character at (1 2 3 4) is -1, not 0. The table entry 0 in the 2-dimensional row is therefore wrong and should be -1, and the parenthetical claim that the 4-cycle maps to a transposition is false; the orthogonality check in the problem indeed uses -1, confirming the inconsistency.

summary: The page is largely correct: the D_4/Q_8 and A_4 tables, the doubly-transitive proposition, the normal-subgroup proposition, and the second orthogonality check are all consistent. The one genuine error is the value of the 2-dimensional irreducible character of S_4 on the 4-cycle: the 4-cycle maps to a double transposition in S_3, so the lifted standard character is -1 there, not 0. The table row and the parenthetical explanation should be corrected to (2,0,2,-1,-1).
